properties.name: BL4026
properties.notes: Planning application 200122 has resolution to grant permission subject to Section 106 agreement. Site is approximately 50% brownfield, 50% greenfield.. Demolition of 29 garages and development of 46 new dwelling units, including the provision of affordable homes, provided in a mixture of houses and apartments (1 bed / 2 bed / 3 bed / 4 bed) in blocks of between 2.5 to 4 storeys, and the provision of bicycle parking spaces, car parking spaces and public realm works.
